card.text: Sun-like star 18 parsecs away whose cold companion is a planet or a brown dwarf, depending on its age.

introduction.text: GJ 504 is a Sun-like star whose measured size allows two ages, 21 million or 4 billion years. The answer decides whether its companion b is a planet or a brown dwarf.

sources.label: Bonnefoy et al. 2018
sources.quote: We measure a radius of 1.35+/- 0.04Rsun for GJ504A

sources.label: D'Orazi et al. 2017
sources.quote: a young age of $\sim$ 160 Myr would imply a giant planet as a companion
